# Chart

**Figma:** ❖ Chart (7032:8969): Chart/Line-Chart 6643:63324, Chart/Stack-Bar-Chart 6643:73471, Chart/Chart-Card 6643:63528, Chart/Bar-Chart 15321:84071, Chart/Multi-Line-Chart 15501:3054 (Sector 4 · 6 · 7 · 12), Chart/Donut-Chart 15324:80365, Chart/Radial-Chart 15325:1135, Chart/Heatmap-Chart 15326:1043, Chart/Bar-List 15487:2473, Chart/Bullet-Chart 15487:2516, Chart/Gauge-Chart 15486:2467, Chart/Funnel-Chart 15486:2497, Chart/Area-Chart 15484:2663 (Type Area · Stacked), Chart/Grouped-Bar-Chart 15485:2457, Chart/Combo-Chart 15485:2519 (spec docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md; phase 2: docs/research/chart-phase2-spec-2026-10-14.md)  
**Import:** `import { AreaChart, BarChart, BarList, BulletChart, ChartCard, ComboChart, DonutChart, FunnelChart, GaugeChart, GroupedBarChart, HeatmapChart, LineChart, RadialChart, StackBarChart } from "@zen-ds/react";`

One chart family in one style: how a value changes over time (Line, Area), compares across periods or categories (Bar; 2–3 series side by side: Grouped bar), splits a total (Stack bar, Stacked area, Donut), reads two measures in different units over the same periods (Combo), measures against a maximum (Radial), ranks items (Bar list), tracks goals against their targets (Bullet), reads one measure against its maximum and target (Gauge), follows the drop-off between stages (Funnel) or spreads over two dimensions (Heatmap), framed by a Chart Card with a title, a figure and a range switch. Every chart draws itself in when it mounts and when its data changes.

## Use it for
- A trend over 4–12 periods → LineChart.
- Against last year, the plan or a second measure over the same periods → LineChart compare (one dashed comparison line, with a legend).
- Compare periods or categories → BarChart (vertical).
- Long category names or a goal per bar → BarChart orientation="horizontal" with target.
- A forecast → projected bars.
- Part-to-whole across periods → StackBarChart with a legend.
- One measure over time where its volume matters as much as its trend (hours, sessions) → AreaChart.
- 2–4 parts of a total over time → AreaChart type="stacked" (the top line is the total, the legend names the bands).
- 2–3 measures side by side per period or category (invoiced vs. collected, this year vs. last) → GroupedBarChart with its legend.
- Parts of one total → StackBarChart.
- Two measures in different units over the same periods (revenue and margin %, hours and utilisation) → ComboChart: bars on the start axis, a line on the end axis.
- A share on a fixed 0 – 100% axis → lineMax={100}.
- Shares of one total (2–7) → DonutChart.
- 1–4 measures against the same maximum (budget used, goals) → RadialChart.
- A value per day × hour, or any row × column grid → HeatmapChart.
- A ranking of 3–8 items with their values (top clients, pages, products) → BarList, ranked largest first: the names sit in the bars, the values line up at the end.
- Many rows to sort, filter or export → Table.
- 1–4 goals against their targets, each in its own unit (revenue, new clients, utilisation) → BulletChart.
- Shares of the same maximum as rings → RadialChart.
- One progress value → ProgressBar.
- One measure against its maximum, with or without a target (utilisation, hours this week) → GaugeChart (several measures on one maximum: RadialChart; a plain progress value: ProgressBar).
- 3–6 steps where each keeps part of the one before (leads to signed, applications to hires) → FunnelChart, first stage first (categories that aren't steps: BarList or BarChart).
- Dashboard tiles → ChartCard (icon, description, value) next to Metric Cards.
- A phone screen whose one main chart is the point → the chart straight on the screen, without a Chart Card (its padding costs the plot its width): a heading, a full-width Segmented, the chart.

## Use something else for
- One number → Metric / MetricCard.
- Exact values to compare or export → Table.
- More than ~7 series or slices → split the chart or use a Table.
- A donut for values over time → LineChart or BarChart.
- One progress value with a label → ProgressBar / ProgressCircle, not a RadialChart.
- Values over time, or more than 8 items, in a BarList → BarChart or a Table.
- Values without a target in a BulletChart → BarList or BarChart.
- A gauge for values over time or for several measures → LineChart, RadialChart or BulletChart.
- A funnel for categories, or for stages that grow → BarList or BarChart.
- More than 3 series in a GroupedBarChart, or stacked areas whose series aren't parts of one total → StackBarChart, LineChart or a Table.
- A ComboChart for two measures in the same unit → GroupedBarChart or LineChart compare.

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/chart.json`.

### LineChart
Figma Chart/Line-Chart (6643:63324): an Accent/Solid 2px line over an area fading Accent/Solid → Accent/Subtle, on a dashed Border/Neutral/Pale grid with 6 Y labels; each X value is a sector, the active one marked by an Active/Accent/Solid rule (idle sectors draw none, as Figma's Sector Default) and a Tooltip with its value. Like Figma's Chart-Visual it starts at the plot's left edge (level with the first value) and ends on the last sector's centre. With `compare` it is Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart (set 15501:3054, Sector 4 · 6 · 7 · 12): the same chart plus one dashed Border/Neutral/Solid line at 40%, both values in the Tooltip and a legend. ←/→, Home/End move between points.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartPoint[]` | — | One point per period (`{ label, value }`). Keep 4–12 periods. |
| `label` | `string` | — | What the line measures ("Invoiced"), named in the legend and the summary once there is a `compare`. Default: the aria-label. |
| `compare` | `ChartCompare` | — | A comparison over the same periods — last year, the plan, what was collected — drawn as a 2px Border/Neutral/Solid line at 40%, dashed 4 / 5, with a legend (Figma Chart/Multi-Line-Chart): one value per point of `data`, in order. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary (`$23.4K`, `52 GB`). Default: 1.2K. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height of the plot in px, lanes included (a seventh of it for the Tooltip lane on top and one for the X labels below, as Figma's 14-row Trend grid). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue invoiced per month, Apr – Sep 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The point active at first (its Tooltip shows). Default: the last one. |
| `curve` | `"smooth" \| "linear"` | `"smooth"` | `smooth` (default, Figma's curve) or `linear` segments. |
| `fill` | `"area" \| "none" \| "gradient"` | `"area"` | The area under the line: `area` (default: Figma's fade, Accent/Solid at the top to Accent/Subtle at the baseline, at 30%) or `none`; `gradient` is deprecated and draws the same area. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | The legend of the line and its comparison (default on with `compare`; colour is never the only key). |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Legend above or below the plot (default bottom). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw the line in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |
| `showAverage` | `boolean` | `false` | A dotted line at the mean of the line (not the comparison), tagged "Avg $95.4K" (Figma Show Average). |

### BarChart
Bar chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): Chart/Sector/Primary bars with Corner-Radius/Small, the active one Chart/Sector/Secondary with its Tooltip; projected bars and target tracks hatched in Border/Neutral/Subtle. Vertical: the Line chart's frame (dashed grid, 6 Y labels, X pills, ←/→). Horizontal: a category column, 24px bars, a value column at the end of the rows (the active one in Strongest; no Tooltip floats over the bars, the user 2026-10-13) and a value axis below (↑/↓). Home/End jump to the first and last bar. Figma Chart/Bar-Chart 15321:84071 (Orientation=Vertical 15321:80574 · Horizontal 15321:82941); the hatch is .Chart/Hatch 15321:475.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | `vertical` columns over periods (default) or `horizontal` bars for categories with longer names (Q1–Q4, teams). |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height of a vertical plot in px, lanes included. Horizontal charts take the height of their rows. |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue per month, Jan – Dec 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The bar active at first (painted Chart/Sector/Secondary, its Tooltip shown). Default: the last bar that isn't projected. |
| `color` | `string` | — | Colour of the bars. Default Chart/Sector/Primary. |

### DonutChart
Donut chart in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): slices in palette order, parted by 4px gaps of the same width from the hole to the rim, each slice's corners rounded 4px, a Surface/Default % pill (Label/Small/Medium) on each slice of 6% or more, and the total in the centre (Heading/4, Caption/Regular caption) — or, with `totalPosition="start"`, beside the ring above the legend (Body/Small/Regular caption, Heading/2 figure, as the Chart Card's description and value). Hover or ←/→ pick a slice: the centre shows it and the others dim; Home/End jump to the first and last slice, and leaving the chart shows the total again. Figma Chart/Donut-Chart 15324:80365 (Legend=Bottom · Start; Size=Small 120 · Medium 168 · Large 240 · XLarge 320).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartSlice[]` | — | The shares of one total (`{ id, label, value }`), drawn clockwise from 12 o'clock in palette order. Keep 2–7 slices. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats the centre figure and the summary. |
| `size` | `ChartRingSize \| number` | `"medium"` | Diameter (Figma Size): `small` 120 · `medium` 168 (default) · `large` 240 · `xlarge` 320 px, in either spelling (`sm` … `xl`); a number still sets px. The ring is 22% of it; it never grows past its box, and a stretched Chart Card grows it. Small shows the centre figure alone (Body/Base/Bold), XLarge in Heading/3. |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows ("Spending by category, September 2026"). |
| `value` | `ReactNode` | — | The total figure. Default: the total, formatted. The active slice's value replaces it while one is picked. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | The caption of the total ("Invoiced in Q3"). Default: the locale's “Total”. |
| `totalPosition` | `"centre" \| "start"` | `"centre"` | Where the total sits: in the hole (`centre`, default), or above the legend in a start column beside the ring (`start`: the hole stays empty, the legend lists down that column; Figma Total=Start). |
| `showPercent` | `boolean` | `true` | A % pill on every slice of 6% or more (default true). |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | The legend names every slice (default true; colour is never the only key). |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "start" \| "end"` | `"bottom"` | Legend below (default), above, or beside the ring (start / end). With `totalPosition="start"` it is always in the start column, under the total. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Grow every slice from its start angle on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### BarList
Bar list: a ranking of 3–8 items, each a 32px row whose bar is as long as its share of the leader (Color Chart Sector/Primary at 24%, the active row 48%, Corner-Radius/Small), the name inside the bar (Body/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest, Spacing/Padding/Small in) and the value at the end (Body/Small/Medium, Strongest, a column Spacing/Gap/Small after the bars); rows Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart, optional column labels above (Caption/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light). ↑/↓ and Home/End move the active row, hover picks one; the summary reads its name and value. Figma Chart/Bar-List 15487:2473 (the chart body; the header is ChartCard's).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartPoint[]` | — | One row per item (`{ label, value }`), already ranked by you, largest first: the list never reorders, and the largest value is the full length every other bar is measured against. Keep 3–8 rows (fold the rest into "Other"). |
| `headers` | `{ label: ReactNode; value: ReactNode }` | — | Column labels above the rows: what the items are (start) and what the values measure (end), e.g. `{ label: "Client", value: "Revenue" }`. Caption/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats each row's value and the summary ("$96,400"). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the list ranks and over which range ("Revenue by client, 2026 so far"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | `0` | The row active at first, its bar at 48% (the others 24%). Default 0: the leader. ↑/↓, Home/End and hover move it. |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Grow the bars from the start on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### BulletChart
Bullet chart: 1–4 goals, each a row with its label (Body/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest) and "actual of target" (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base) above a 16px Corner-Radius/Rounded track (Border/Neutral/Subtle/ Pressed at 50%: Figma's Color Chart Sector/On-Color/Tertiary), the actual as an 8px Color Chart Sector/Primary bar inset 4px, and the target as a 3px Color Chart Sector/Secondary tick 24px tall; rows Spacing/Gap/Medium apart, label and track Spacing/Gap/XSmall. A legend (Spacing/Gap/Small between items) names the bar and the tick. ↑/↓ and Home/End pick a row (the others' marks dim), hover too; the summary reads "Revenue: $798K of $900K (1 of 3)". Figma Chart/Bullet-Chart 15487:2516 (the chart body and Show Legend; the header is ChartCard's).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartBullet[]` | — | One row per goal (`{ label, value, target, max }`); each row has its own scale, so goals in different units can share the chart. Keep 1–4 rows. |
| `actualLabel` | `string` | — | The legend's name for the bar. Default the label "Actual". |
| `targetLabel` | `string` | — | The legend's name for the tick. Default the label "Target". |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the legend that names the bar and the tick (Figma Show Legend, default true). |
| `legendPosition` | `Extract<ChartLegendPosition, "top" \| "bottom">` | `"bottom"` | Legend below the rows (default) or above them. |
| `format` | `(value: number, row: ChartBullet) => string` | — | Formats the value and the target of a row ("$798K of $900K") and the summary. It gets the row too, so each goal can take its own unit: `(v, row) => (row.label === "Utilisation" ? v + "%" : String(v))`. |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the goals are and for which period ("Quarter goals, Q3 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart (not the legend). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | A row active at first (the others' marks dim). Default none: every row reads alike until one is picked. |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Grow the bars from the start and fade the ticks in on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### GaugeChart
Gauge in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): one measure against a maximum as a half ring a tenth of its width thick (Figma innerRadius 0.8) — the track Background/Neutral/Subtle, the value Chart/Sector/Primary (Color Chart Sector/Primary) with flat ends, the target a 3px round-capped Chart/Sector/Secondary tick 4px past both edges. The reading sits in the hole: the figure Heading/2 · Content/Neutral/Strongest over a Body/Small/Regular · Content/Neutral/Base caption; the scale's ends (Label/Small/Medium · Content/Neutral/Light) sit centred under the ring's two ends. The legend (Figma Show Legend) names the value and the target, Spacing/Gap/Small apart. It is a `meter` (aria-valuenow, min 0, max `max`, value text "Billable 82%, Target 85%"): nothing in it can be picked, so it takes no tab stop. Figma Chart/Gauge-Chart 15486:2467.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `number` | — | The reading, measured from 0 to `max` ("1,052 h", "82"). A value past `max` fills the ring and still reads as it is. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | The value a full half ring stands for (default 100: the value is a percentage). |
| `target` | `number` | — | A goal on the same scale, drawn as a Chart/Sector/Secondary tick across the ring and read under the figure. |
| `actualLabel` | `string` | — | The legend's name for the value ("Billable"), as BulletChart's `actualLabel`. Default "Actual". |
| `targetLabel` | `string` | — | The legend's name for the target and the start of the default caption. Default "Target". |
| `caption` | `ReactNode` | — | The line under the figure. Default: the target ("Target 85%"), or `actualLabel` when there is no target. |
| `size` | `number` | `240` | Width of the half ring in px (default 240, as Figma); the ring is a tenth of it thick. The gauge never grows past its box. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | — | Formats the figure, the target and the end labels. Default: the share of `max` in whole percent ("82%", "0%", "100%"). |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | — | The legend names the value and the target (Figma Show Legend). Default: on when there is a target. |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "start" \| "end"` | `"bottom"` | Legend below (default), above, or beside the gauge (start / end). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the gauge measures, and when ("Billable share of logged hours, September 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart (not the legend). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Sweep the value from 0 on mount and when it changes; the target tick fades in after (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### FunnelChart
Funnel in the shared chart language (docs/research/chart-family-spec-2026-10-12.md): one row per stage — the name (Body/Small/Medium · Content/Neutral/Strongest) over its count (Caption/Regular · Content/Neutral/Base) in an 84px start column, a 32px bar centred in its track as wide as its share of the first stage (Chart/Sector/Primary, the last stage Chart/Sector/Secondary, Corner-Radius/Small), and the share at the end (Body/Small/Medium, right-aligned). Rows Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart, columns Spacing/Gap/Small. Stages are pickable like horizontal bars: hover or ↑/↓ and Home/End pick one (the others dim) and the summary reads its name, count and share. Figma Chart/Funnel-Chart 15486:2497.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartPoint[]` | — | One stage per step, first contact first (`{ label, value }`): each bar is as wide as its share of the first stage. Keep 3–6 stages. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats the counts under the stage names and in the summary (the shares are whole percent of the first stage). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the funnel shows and over which range ("Leads to signed projects, Q3 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart (not the legend). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The stage picked at first (the others dim). Default none: every stage at full strength until one is hovered or reached with ↑/↓. |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Open every bar from its centre on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### AreaChart
Figma Chart/Area-Chart (set 15484:2663; Type=Area 15484:2552 · Type=Stacked 15484:2605): straight 2px lines (round caps) in the Color Chart Sector styles (`chartPalette`) from the first period's centre to the last, each over an area that fades top → bottom from Solid to Subtle at 30% (Figma 2026-10-14: Background/Accent, then Neutral, then Support/Cyan, as the line chart's area; `chartFades`) — one area, or stacked bands — on the bar charts' frame: Y labels (Label/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light) right-aligned in a column Spacing/Padding/XSmall before the plot, dashed 4 / 4 Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines, a solid Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle baseline, X labels under it (the active one a pill). The active period shows a 12px dot on each line (Surface/Default, 2px ring in the series colour), a 1px Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle rule from the top dot to the baseline and the Tooltip beside the dot, a dot's width away: the value, or the stack's total. The legend (Figma Show Legend) sits Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot, its items Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End move between periods; hover picks one.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartDatum[]` | — | One period per item, a value per series id (`{ label: "Sep", values: { design: 750, … } }`). Keep 4–12 periods. |
| `series` (required) | `ChartSeries[]` | — | The measured series, bottom first: one for `type="area"` (only the first is drawn), 2–4 for `"stacked"` (harness: chart/area-series-count). Lines walk the Figma styles Color Chart Sector/Primary …, areas fade from the slot's Solid to its Subtle (Accent, Neutral, Support Cyan …; `chartFades`), unless a series sets `color`. |
| `type` | `"area" \| "stacked"` | `"area"` | Figma Type: `area` (default) — one measure as a line over its fading area; `stacked` — 2–4 series as fading bands stacked bottom-up with a line on top of each band, so the top line reads the period's total. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary (`2,210 h`, `$23.4K`). Default: 1.2K. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height of the plot in px, lanes included (6px above the grid for the top Y label, 28px below it for the X labels). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows and over which range ("Billable hours per month, Apr – Sep 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart frame (the axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The period active at first (its dots, rule and Tooltip show). Default: the last one. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | — | Figma Show Legend: the legend names every series. Default: on for `stacked`, off for a single `area` (the card title names its one measure). Keep it on a stacked chart (harness: chart/series-need-legend). |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Legend above or below the plot (default bottom). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Wipe the areas in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### GroupedBarChart
Figma Chart/Grouped-Bar-Chart (15485:2457): per period a group of 12px bars, one per series, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall apart, centred in the period's column (with room to spare the group grows to 70% of the column, bars up to 32px); each bar takes its series' Color Chart Sector style (`chartPalette`) with Corner-Radius/XSmall on its top corners. The bar charts' frame: Y labels (Label/Small/Medium, Content/Neutral/Light) right-aligned Spacing/Padding/XSmall before the plot, dashed 4 / 4 Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines over a solid Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle baseline, X labels under it (the active one a pill). The active group keeps its colours (the others ease to 88%, as stacked columns), its Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle rule and the Tooltip in the top lane, which reads every series' value after its dot. The legend (Figma Show Legend) sits Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot, its items Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End move between groups; hover picks one.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartDatum[]` | — | One group per period or category, a value per series id (`{ label: "Sep", values: { invoiced: 105700, collected: 88300 } }`). Keep 3–12 groups. |
| `series` (required) | `ChartSeries[]` | — | The compared series, 2–3, side by side in each group in this order (harness: chart/grouped-series-count). Colours walk the Figma styles Color Chart Sector/Primary · Secondary · Tertiary unless a series sets `color`. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats axis labels, the Tooltip and the summary. Default: 1.2K. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height of the plot in px, lanes included (36px above the grid for the Tooltip, 28px below it for the X labels). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows and over which range ("Invoiced and collected per month, Apr – Sep 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart frame (the axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The group active at first (its Tooltip shows every series' value). Default: the last one. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Figma Show Legend: the legend names every series; keep it (harness: chart/series-need-legend). Default on. |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Legend above or below the plot (default bottom). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Grow the bars from the baseline on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### ComboChart
Figma Chart/Combo-Chart (15485:2519): two measures over the same periods on two axes. Bars (Color Chart Sector/Primary, 20px, half the period's column with room to spare, up to 40px; Corner-Radius/XSmall on the top corners) read the start axis; a straight 2px Color Chart Sector/Secondary line (round caps) with an 8px dot on every period (Surface/Default, 2px ring) reads the end axis. Both axes take Label/Small/Medium in Content/Neutral/Light, Spacing/Padding/XSmall from the plot (the start one right-aligned, the end one left-aligned) and share the dashed 4 / 4 Border/Neutral/Pale gridlines over a solid Border/Active/Neutral/Subtle baseline. The active period keeps its bar (the others ease to 88%), its dot grows to 12px, and the Tooltip in the top lane reads both values after their dots; X labels under the plot (the active one a pill). The legend (Figma Show Legend) names both measures Spacing/Gap/Medium under the plot, its items Spacing/Gap/Small apart. ←/→ and Home/End move between periods; hover picks one.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `ChartComboDatum[]` | — | One period per item (`{ label: "Sep", bar: 105700, line: 41 }`). Keep 4–12 periods. |
| `barLabel` (required) | `string` | — | What the bars measure ("Revenue"), named in the legend, the Tooltip order and the summary (harness: chart/combo-needs-labels). |
| `lineLabel` (required) | `string` | — | What the line measures ("Margin"), named in the legend and the summary. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats the bars' values and the start axis (`$105.7K`). Default: 1.2K. |
| `lineFormat` | `(value: number) => string` | `(value: number) => (Math.abs(value) >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(value / 100) / 10}K` : `${Math.round(value * 10) / 10}`)` | Formats the line's values and the end axis (`41%`). Default: 1.2K. |
| `lineMax` | `number` | — | The top of the end axis (100 for a share in %). Default: a round top over the line's values, on the same gridlines as the start axis. |
| `height` | `number` | `280` | Height of the plot in px, lanes included (36px above the grid for the Tooltip, 28px below it for the X labels). |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` | — | What the chart shows and over which range ("Revenue and margin per month, Apr – Sep 2026"). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Extra class on the chart frame (both axes and the plot; the legend sits outside it). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the root `<div>` (the chart block that holds the plot and its legend). |
| `initialIndex` | `number` | — | The period active at first (its Tooltip reads both values). Default: the last one. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | `true` | Figma Show Legend: the legend names the bars and the line; keep it (harness: chart/series-need-legend). Default on. |
| `legendPosition` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Legend above or below the plot (default bottom). |
| `animate` | `boolean` | `true` | Grow the bars from the baseline and wipe the line in from the left on mount and when the data changes (default true; reduced motion fades). |

### ChartCard
Figma Chart/Chart-Card (6643:63528): Card Flat Medium (padding 24, radius 24) → header · Segmented · chart, gap 16. The header row holds an optional icon, the title and the open chevron; a description and the headline value follow it (every Figma chart card's Show Icon · Icon · Title · Show Description · Description · Show Value · Value · Show Ranges · Show Open properties).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Header Label (Heading/Subheading). |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title: one level below the nearest heading above (default 3: a card inside an h2 section; 2 when the card sits directly under the page h1). The look stays Heading/Subheading — the level follows the outline, not the size. An EmptyState in `children` takes the next level in Body/Extra/Bold, below the card title. |
| `icon` | `IconName \| ReactNode` | — | Icon before the title (20px, Content/Neutral/Strongest): an icon name or a node. Decorative; the title names the card. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | — | One line under the title that says what the figure is ("Available revenue in your wallet"), Body/Small/Regular. |
| `value` | `ReactNode` | — | The headline figure the chart explains ("$4,346.00"), Heading/2 (Figma Chart-Card Heading > Value). |
| `onOpen` | `() => void` | — | Figma Header trailing Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary (chevron): opens the full report. |
| `openLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the open button. Default: the locale's “Open report”. |
| `ranges` | `SegmentedOption[]` | — | Figma Segmented (Secondary) range switch. |
| `range` | `string` | — |  |
| `onRangeChange` | `(id: string) => void` | — |  |
| `rangesFullWidth` | `boolean` | `true` | The range switch fills the card and splits it into equal items (Figma Segmented FILL, default); `false` hugs its items, as on a wide card where a full-width switch would stretch far past its labels (Figma HUG). |
| `theme` | `"shadow" \| "flat" \| "pale" \| "border" \| "on-container" \| "solid" \| "subtle" \| "semi-pale"` | `"flat"` | Figma nested Card Theme: Flat (default) inside a panel or section; Shadow when the chart card sits on the canvas next to other Shadow cards (metric cards on a dashboard). |
| `color` | `"neutral" \| "brand" \| "cyan" \| "violet" \| "green" \| "yellow" \| "orange" \| "blue" \| "purple" \| "accent"` | — | Figma nested Card Color, for theme="pale", "subtle" or "solid": the Card's hue (Solid Neutral is the dark widget; see Card). |
| `surface` | `"default" \| "alt" \| "flat"` | — | Figma nested Card Surface: default · alt (Flat, Border) · flat (Border only, on a Canvas/Flat page); see Card. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | The chart, or an EmptyState before there is data (keep the card title; the Empty State is set one level below it). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Forwarded to the Card's root `<div>`. |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides: props of the open button and range control it draws, by layer (`{ Open: { level: "secondary" }, "Ranges/Item[week]": { level: "primary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets onOpen / ranges. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface ChartBullet { label: string; value: number; target: number; max?: number; }
interface ChartComboDatum { label: string; bar: number; line: number }
interface ChartCompare { label: string; values: number[] }
interface ChartDatum { label: string; values: Record<string, number> }
type ChartLegendPosition = "top" | "bottom" | "start" | "end"
interface ChartPoint { label: string; value: number; projected?: boolean; target?: number; }
type ChartRingSize = "small" | "medium" | "large" | "xlarge" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"
interface ChartSeries { id: string; label: string; color?: string; }
interface ChartSlice { id: string; label: string; value: number; color?: string }
type SegmentedOption = { id: string; label: ReactNode; leading?: IconName | ReactNode; badge?: ReactNode; state?: SegmentedState; disabled?: boolean; "aria-label"?: string; }
type SegmentedState = "default" | "hover" | "focused" | "disabled"
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Focus the chart |
| ← / → | Previous / next point, bar, slice or ring (the Tooltip or the centre follows) |
| ↑ / ↓ | Previous / next bar (horizontal BarChart); row above / below (HeatmapChart); previous / next row (BarList, BulletChart); previous / next stage (FunnelChart) |
| Home / End | First / last item (the heatmap: first / last cell of the row) |

## ✅ Do
- Size a Donut or Radial by name, as Figma's Size: small 120 (a tile, several charts in a row; the centre shows the figure alone), medium 168 (a chart card, the default), large 240 (a wide card, the total beside the ring), xlarge 320 (a hero card) (harness: chart/ring-size-named). A stretched Chart Card grows the ring from there.
- Always give the chart an aria-label that says what it shows and over which range (harness: chart/needs-name).
- Format values for people (`$23.4K`, `52 GB`, `1,990 h`) with `format`.
- Keep the legend whenever colour tells series, slices or rings apart (harness: chart/stack-needs-legend, chart/shares-need-legend, chart/series-need-legend) and the heatmap's Less → More scale (harness: chart/heatmap-needs-scale).
- Mark a forecast `projected` so it reads as not earned yet; show a goal as a `target` track, not as another series.
- Use the Segmented range switch in the card instead of separate charts per range, and key the chart by the range so it draws in again.
- Turn on showAverage when the question is "above or below normal?"; leave it off when the trend itself is the point.
- Rank a BarList yourself, largest first, and fold the tail into "Other" past 8 rows (harness: chart/bar-list-ranked, chart/bar-list-rows); keep a BulletChart to 1–4 goals (harness: chart/bullet-rows); pass a GaugeChart its `max` when the value isn't a percentage (harness: chart/gauge-in-range); give a FunnelChart 3–6 stages in order, each no larger than the one before (harness: chart/funnel-stages).
- Give an AreaChart one series, or 2–4 with type="stacked" (harness: chart/area-series-count); keep a GroupedBarChart to 2–3 series (harness: chart/grouped-series-count); name both measures of a ComboChart with barLabel and lineLabel (harness: chart/combo-needs-labels).
- Lead the card with the figure the chart explains (`value`) and say what it is (`description`).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a line for categories that aren't ordered in time.
- Don't pick custom colours outside the chart palette unless a series has a fixed brand colour.
- Don't put a chart where the user needs exact values; add a Table.
- Don't start a bar's axis above zero or stretch a donut past ~7 slices.
- Don't mix chart styles on one screen: every chart takes the shared grid, labels, Tooltip, legend and motion.

## Accessibility
- The plot is a focusable group (aria-roledescription="chart") named by aria-label; a live summary reads the active item ("Q2: $14.8K (2 of 4)").
- ←/→ and Home/End move between points, bars, slices and rings (↑/↓ for horizontal bars, bar-list rows and bullet goals); the heatmap moves in 2D. Pointer hover picks the same item.
- Legends label every colour; Donut and Radial summarise every slice or ring before one is picked, a FunnelChart every stage with its count and share.
- GaugeChart is a meter (role="meter", aria-valuenow / min / max) named by aria-label, its value text the reading and the target ("Billable 78%, Target 85%"); nothing in it can be picked, so it takes no tab stop.
- The draw-in only fades under reduced motion (Motion/Movement 0); nothing wipes, sweeps or scales.

## Content
- Title names the measure ("Revenue", "Hours against capacity"); the description says what the figure is and over which range ("Invoiced so far in 2026"); axis labels are short (Q1, Jan, 9 am).
- Before there is data, keep the card title and put an EmptyState in the card: it takes the next heading level in Body/Extra/Bold and the Small size, so it never outranks or outsizes the card title.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card/color-ignored` | warn | Card color is the Figma Color of theme="pale" and theme="subtle" (nine hues) and theme="solid"; Shadow, Flat, Border and On-Container have no Color and ignore it. | `zen-allow-card-color: <reason>` |
| `card/surface-ignored` | warn | Figma Card Surface per theme: alt on Flat and Border (Shadow on alt renders as Flat), flat on Border only; Pale, On-Container and Solid keep their own fill. | `zen-allow-card-surface: <reason>` |
| `card/solid-color` | error | Figma draws Theme=Solid in Neutral, Brand, Cyan, Yellow, Orange and Accent only; other hues render as Solid Neutral (they would fail contrast). Accent is Solid only: a Pale accent renders as Pale Neutral. | `zen-allow-card-color: <reason>` |
| `card/pale-on-canvas-default` | error | On a Canvas/Default page (the grey canvas: AppShell and PlatformPhone unless their canvas says otherwise, a painting ZenProvider) a colour box is theme="subtle" (Support/<Color>/Subtle): Pale fades into the grey. Pale is for white pages (Canvas/Alt, Canvas/Flat, a Surface screen) and imagery (user rule 2026-10-17). | `zen-allow-card-pale-canvas: <reason>` |
| `chart/stack-needs-legend` | error | Stack-bar charts keep their legend so colour is never the only key. | `zen-allow-chart-legend: <reason>` |
| `chart/needs-name` | error | Every chart is named by an aria-label that says what it shows and over which range. | `zen-allow-chart-name: <reason>` |
| `chart/shares-need-legend` | error | Donut slices, radial rings and a line chart's comparison keep their legend so colour is never the only key. | `zen-allow-chart-legend: <reason>` |
| `chart/ring-size-named` | warn | A ring chart takes a named size (Figma Size): small 120 · medium 168 · large 240 · xlarge 320, not a number of px. | `zen-allow-ring-size-px: <reason>` |
| `chart/heatmap-needs-scale` | warn | A heatmap keeps its Less → More scale so the five steps can be read. | `zen-allow-heatmap-scale: <reason>` |
| `chart/bar-list-rows` | warn | A BarList ranks 3–8 items; past 8, keep the top 7 and fold the rest into an "Other" row, or use a Table. | `zen-allow-bar-list-rows: <reason>` |
| `chart/bar-list-ranked` | warn | A BarList never reorders its data: pass it ranked, largest first (an "Other" row may close the list). | `zen-allow-bar-list-ranked: <reason>` |
| `chart/bullet-rows` | warn | A BulletChart shows 1–4 goals; more goals go in a Table or a second chart. | `zen-allow-bullet-rows: <reason>` |
| `chart/gauge-in-range` | warn | A GaugeChart's value and target sit on its 0 – max scale (max defaults to 100): pass max when the value isn't a percentage. | `zen-allow-gauge-range: <reason>` |
| `chart/funnel-stages` | warn | A FunnelChart shows 3–6 stages, in order, each no larger than the one before it. | `zen-allow-funnel-stages: <reason>` |
| `chart/series-need-legend` | error | Stacked areas, grouped bars and a combo chart keep their legend so colour is never the only key. | `zen-allow-chart-legend: <reason>` |
| `chart/area-series-count` | warn | An AreaChart draws one series, or 2–4 stacked as parts of one total (type="stacked"). | `zen-allow-area-series: <reason>` |
| `chart/grouped-series-count` | warn | A GroupedBarChart compares 2–3 series side by side. | `zen-allow-grouped-series: <reason>` |
| `chart/combo-needs-labels` | error | A ComboChart names both measures (barLabel, lineLabel): its legend, Tooltip order and summary read them. | `zen-allow-combo-labels: <reason>` |
| `api/overrides-studio-only` | error | `overrides` (Figma instance overrides of the layers a component draws itself: `{ "Sub-Action": { level: "danger" } }`) is written by Zen Studio on the pages it makes; hand-written code sets the component's own props or composes the parts (the user's call, 2026-10-10). | `zen-allow-overrides: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
